notes: The combined parcel dataset retains every parcel in the source opportunity snapshot; it does not assign a composite candidate or recommendation label.
Need, transit, ownership, vacancy, underbuilt status, capacity changes, and review requirements remain independent fields so users can construct and compare their own screens.
Capacity values are analytical archetype tests. They are not a proposed unit mix, a legal entitlement, a financial feasibility result, or a prediction that construction will occur.
Tract-level need values are repeated on parcels for filtering only. Census counts and gaps must be aggregated from the tract-grain family_housing_need dataset, not summed from parcel rows.
Summary tables aggregate parcel counts and modeled capacity independently by community area, ward, zoning class, and transit band; they do not create a sparse cross-product of all four geographies.
